changelog: Modern Dark Glass Context Menu: Custom borderless context menu eliminating native Win32 white borders with sleek slate border (#2a324b) and dark glass container
Interactive Menu Hover Highlights: Vibrant primary red highlight for Connect, soft crimson for Delete danger action, and smooth slate highlights for Edit and Rename
Global Click-Outside Dismissal: Auto-dismiss on click outside, window blur, or Escape key
Card Elevation & Visual Polish: Card hover elevation (#3b4664 highlight), live green status indicator dot (● Online), and high-tech ID monospace chip (#211823)
Refined Action Toolbar: Sleek pill buttons for '✏️ Edit' and '🗑️ Delete' with cyan and crimson hover glows
Input Focus Glow: Smooth red (#ef4444) border glow on focused input fields across all modal dialogs
Recent & Favorites Custom Session Management: Rename, edit details, and delete sessions directly from UI
Startup & Connect Crash Immunity: Thread-safe post_ui dispatch queue eliminating cross-thread Tcl mutations
Seamless In-App Title Bar (CSD): Integrated minimize, maximize, and close controls in top tab bar
Authenticode Signed Binaries: Digitally signed with SHA-256 and DigiCert RFC 3161 timestamps
